value.rationale: For a canonical cubic lattice strip, the Möbius twist reverses the circumference parity at which a fully favoured bipartition is possible, producing two additional finite-size magnetic crossings with exact labelled coexistence counts. The signed exponential correction to the saturation degeneracy quantifies a finite-size boundary-condition effect while leaving bulk entropy unchanged. The statement is a natural complete finite-system magnetic classification, not a routine single coefficient or a generic transfer formalism.
